finding.statement: ATT-0112/CLM-0112-8 (Grauert, pi_*L locally free of rank three, Zariski-locally trivial Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle, reduced-support open, S_6-ordering torsor) is established over smooth finite-type atlases of H^bal and does not transfer verbatim to etale atlases of Hbar^bal = [H^bal/PGL_2]. The packet convention W_5 = (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C involves gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5); over the PGL_2-quotient the target P^1 descends only as a Severi-Brauer/P^1-bundle whose Brauer class can obstruct the odd twist O(5), so W_5, L = W_5 tensor omega^{-1} and pi_*L need not exist as sheaves on such an atlas, and Zariski-local triviality of the P^2-bundle is not available there. Projectivization is insensitive to the twist, so the Abel-Jacobi fibration still exists as a Severi-Brauer scheme of relative dimension two and the dimension count 15+2 = 17 survives; alternatively one obtains dim(image) <= 20 - 3 = 17 directly from three-dimensional PGL_2-orbits with finite stabilizers, consistent with dim Hbar^bal = 18 - 3 = 15. Attempts that need the 17-dimensional model must supply one of these two repairs rather than cite CLM-0112-8 unchanged.
